business.description: Mahasagar Travels Limited is engaged in providing tourist transport services in Gujarat, operating a fleet of luxury buses with air conditioning and focusing on pollution-free environment-friendly buses.

products.name: Tourist transport services
products.note: Core business is providing service to tourists with luxury bus fleet

outlook.statement: New fleets of buses will increase tourist business and facilitate tourists with latest available facilities which will increase overall business and profitability in coming years.

Travel and tourism industries are being promoted by government. Gujarat Government is actively promoting tourism facilities and destinations in the state. With the increase in travelling tendency of people for the leisure and business overall industry is viewing good prospects.
Company is planning to develop more area related to tourism, hotel business and infrastructure facilities and in construction & real estate fields.
Company is planning to grab infrastructure development opportunities related to real estate, travel and tourism.

capex_plans.item: Gradually replacing old buses with environment friendly luxurious buses in phased manner

risks: Major fluctuation in the price of petroleum products having vital impact on profitability and performance
International market having great effect on increase in crude price and increase in dollar value against rupee
Realty sector in India showing slow movements, market becoming steadier and higher inflation rate leads government to curb financial resources to realty sector
Government policies and regional policies can affect the performance of the company
New players joining in the competition
International market very volatile with respect to petroleum products
Real estate sector in India facing many challenges for new development
